subject: SOW and timing: TrustBridge assessment vs Vanta renewal
messages:
From: Samantha Huang <samantha@trustbridge.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOW and timeline: TrustBridge assessment + Vanta overlap

Hi Markus —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Attached is our draft SOW for a 6-week security posture assessment (TrustBridge_SOW_v1.pdf) and a quick pricing sheet showing the overlap options if you run our assessment in parallel with Vanta onboarding (Vanta_pricing_sheet.xlsx).

High-level summary:
- Week 1–2: Discovery and evidence collection (security owners + infra).
- Week 3–4: Control mapping and gap prioritization.
- Week 5–6: Remediation plan + enablement workshop.

Questions for you:
1) Do you want TrustBridge to run discovery in parallel with your Vanta onboarding (we can coordinate to avoid duplicate evidence pulls), or would you prefer we sequence assessment after the Vanta implementation to reduce noise?
2) Any hard procurement timeline / PO dates we should hit to reserve an August onboarding slot?

If helpful I can split the SOW into a discovery-only engagement vs full assessment (saves budget up front).

Attachments: TrustBridge_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW), Vanta_pricing_sheet.xlsx (overlap options)

Best,
Samantha Huang
Engagement Lead, TrustBridge Consulting
samantha@trustbridge.com
+1 (415) 555-0218

From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Huang <samantha@trustbridge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOW and timeline: TrustBridge assessment + Vanta overlap

Samantha —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the clarity. Two quick notes from our side:

1) High level preference: we want minimal duplication of effort for our SREs. If TrustBridge can scope discovery so it doesn't repeat evidence already captured by Vanta, that would be ideal. Could you call out the exact telemetry + artifact list you need (AWS roles/logs, GCP projects, SSO config, sample user audit logs)?

2) Procurement constraints: finance requires a split approach where we can approve a discovery PO first (up to $18k) and then sign for remediation work after we see the gap report. Please prepare a revised SOW that separates discovery + remediation as discrete line items and gives optional hourly rates for follow-on work.

3) Legal wants a one-page summary of data access and retention specifics before we sign anything. Looping in Jonas for legal redlines. Jonas — can you flag any hard stops on data handling?

I'm attaching a short internal coverage spreadsheet (redwood_security_coverage.xlsx) that maps what we've already instrumented vs what we'd like TrustBridge to validate. If you can align the SOW deliverables to this matrix it will speed approval.

We also have an expiring Vanta subscription renewal due Aug 31. I'd like procurement to avoid paying for overlapping deliverables if TrustBridge will cover the same baseline controls — Marissa, can you propose an approach to the vendor renewal?

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOW and timing: TrustBridge assessment + Vanta renewal (procurement routing)

Markus / team —

Quick procurement take:
- We can issue a discovery PO to TrustBridge for up to $18k immediately (Net 30). I'll prepare the PR today and route for manager approval.
- For Vanta: current renewal invoice is $42k annual and due Aug 31. My recommendation is to pause payment (hold for approval) if TrustBridge discovery will materially replace the baseline controls Vanta claims to validate. We need a short memo to Finance explaining the overlap risk to justify hold.
- Budget note: finance prefers not to have two active engagements of similar scope in the same month. If TrustBridge requests an August start, we should prioritize discovery and defer Vanta renewal until the end of September.

Action items:
- Markus: confirm go/no-go on discovery PO by EOD Mon so I can issue the PR.
- Neha: provide final confirmation on the coverage matrix — if TrustBridge will get AWS CloudTrail + SSO audit logs that's sufficient for discovery.
- Jonas: will legal accept a discovery-only SOW with limited access clause? If not, we may need a redline cycle which will push the start date.

Attaching draft PR language in the drive link (internal) and the redwood_security_coverage.xlsx for reference.

Marissa
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Huang <samantha@trustbridge.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOW and timing: TrustBridge assessment + Vanta overlap — revised SOW and next steps

Thanks everyone — and appreciate the clear asks. Per Markus' request we've produced a revised SOW that separates discovery (fixed fee $16,500) from remediation/enablement (T&M or a fixed follow-on estimate). Please see attached: TrustBridge_SOW_v1_revised.pdf.

Key clarifications included in the revision:
- Evidence list: AWS CloudTrail, IAM role list, SSO config screenshots, sample audit logs (we'll provide specific filenames and API steps to collect).
- Data handling: encrypted at rest, 30-day evidence retention for the engagement, no customer PII requested.
- Onboarding slot: to reserve Aug 17 start we need a signed DocuSign by Aug 10 (link below). If you prefer Sept start we can extend.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.net/TrustBridge/EnvelopeId/abc123
Attachments: TrustBridge_SOW_v1_revised.pdf

If you sign the discovery SOW we'll assign a technical lead and share the evidence collection checklist within 48 hours. Happy to jump on a 30-minute call to walk through the matrix if that's useful.

Best regards,
Samantha Huang
Engagement Lead, TrustBridge Consulting
